SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-28-2008 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SIZELOVE, AERIN M RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BADER, LINDA R $186.00 PRINCIPAL, $30.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $216.00, THE COURT DETERMINES THAT PLAINTIFF'S SECURITY DEPOSIT AT THE TIME SHE VACATED WAS $636.00, INCLUDING ACCURED INTEREST.
